Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c62b43fd69dd62cfc0151253ae239ec3c18bd4b1ab0c372e2f7eba97b310f20d.png] 

In 2020, the production of cement by company C increased by the same percentage as in 2019, over its previous year. The production (in million tonnes) of cement by company C in 2020 (correct to one decimal place) was:
solution:
**Calculation:**

The production of cement by company C in 2018 = 350

The production of cement by company C in 2019 = 400

The percentage increased of cement = [((400-350)/({350)} × 100)]

⇒ ((50)/({350)} × 100)

⇒ (100)/({7)}%</p&
